name: GameCube Controller Adapter (HID)
notes: The Wii U GameCube adapter's report descriptor (WUP-028, 057E:0337), 214 bytes, the bytes nine linux-hardware.org dumps print. Usage Page 0x05 is Game Controls. Ten Application collections declare outputs 0x11 to 0x15 and inputs 0x21 to 0x25, each Report Count equal to the report's length on the wire including its ID byte, so report 0x21 is declared as 37 bytes after the ID and the adapter sends 37 including it. Windows' HID parser rejects this descriptor, so this UMDF2 profile fails with Code 10, as a real adapter does on Windows. gamecube-adapter is the working persona: the same device on the USB/IP transport, which Dolphin, Slippi and SDL open through libusb.

layout.note: The report descriptor declares byte arrays under Game Controls, as the real adapter's does, so it names no axes or buttons for a layout to reference.
